name: shopware-mcp
description: Query and safely manage your Shopware 6 shop: products, orders, customers, stock, health audits and sales reports.
long_description: Connects your AI assistant to the Shopware 6 Admin API. Read-only by default; write tools (stock, product basics, order state, promotions) can be enabled and always default to a dry run. Includes a one-shot shop health audit, aggregated sales reports and schema-aware access to any Shopware entity with credentials stripped.

shopware_url.title: Shop URL
shopware_url.description: Base URL of your shop, e.g. https://shop.example.com

client_secret.title: Integration secret access key
client_secret.description: Shown once when the integration is created

allow_write.title: Enable write tools
allow_write.description: Registers stock_set, product_update, order_state_transition and promotion_toggle. Every write defaults to a dry run.

tools.name: shop_info
tools.description: Version, edition, default currency and language

tools.name: shop_audit
tools.description: One-shot health check with prioritised findings

tools.name: sales_report
tools.description: Revenue, order counts, timeline and top products for a period

tools.name: sales_channels_list

tools.name: products_search

tools.name: products_get

tools.name: stock_get

tools.name: orders_search
tools.description: Search orders with state, payment and delivery state

tools.name: orders_get

tools.name: customers_search

tools.name: categories_list

tools.name: plugins_list

tools.name: entity_search

tools.name: entity_schema

prompts.name: order_summary
prompts.description: Summarize one order for a support reply
prompts.text: Load order ${arguments.orderNumber} with orders_get and write a short, friendly support summary: date, items, total, payment and delivery state, tracking codes and shipping address. Flag anything that looks stuck.

prompts.name: low_stock_report
prompts.description: List active products below a stock threshold
prompts.text: Use products_search with a range filter stock < ${arguments.threshold} and active = true, includeVariants = true, sorted by stock ascending. Produce a table with product number, name, stock, available stock and manufacturer, and end with the total count.
